newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB Australian wheat indicator prices-Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB Australian wheat indicator prices-Sept 30.

text.p: International prices for milling and Durum wheat were unchanged with increasing world wheat and coarse grain production and lack of any export business weighing over the market, the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said. Wheat indicator prices for multi-grade contracts 96/97 and Durum were unchanged. Prices, FOB, in A$ per tonne:

NOTE: The indicator price represents the current state of the international wheat market. It is a cash contract price offered today by the AWB for wheat delivered during the 1996/97 harvest. The offer is valid until 4.30 p.m. Australian Eastern Standard Time (0630 GMT) and Eastern Standard Summer Time (0530 GMT). Indicator prices will be revised daily until October.
